chapter: Fats Waller, marriage and Indian school tours
title: Musician neighbors in Nyack
summary: Moore names jazz musicians who live around Rockland County.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Anyway, I love to play for the old people. And there are some musicians that live around here in Nyack, especially Buddy Christian who is one of the most famous drummers here. He started out with Sauter-Finnegan and also he plays for Steven Scott in the City, one of the society -- they do the same thing like Lester and then there's Tony Barbera who was the saxophone and clarinet player. He's famous here. And then we have -- in my neighborhood here we have Zoot Sims who lives in West Nyack. Also Danny Styles, he lives in Rockland County also, and Herb Gardner, the trombonist, beautiful trombonist and he lives in New City and who else is here -- Marky Markowitz is here.
That's quite a little enclave of musicians in Rockland County here.

Yes, they commute between here and New York, but we love Nyack here because Nyack here I think is one of the last joints that look -- joints -- I meant the cities that looks like an art colony. They have many
